disclaimer: This report combines Nmap reachability observations with communications visible to the Zeek sensor during the stated collection window. Nmap describes reachability from the scanner’s location, while Zeek describes only traffic visible to its sensor. Neither source independently proves that a communication is authorized, required, complete, or representative of all network activity. Candidate firewall rules require policy and business-owner validation before implementation.
